failure_modes.name: vision_nav_low_light
failure_modes.symptoms: position drift at dusk/night; VIO lost; altitude error; hesitation in autonomous flight
failure_modes.mitigation: ensure adequate ambient/IR illumination; limit unaided night ops; GPS/RTK fusion; pre-mapped routes

failure_modes.name: battery_fade
failure_modes.symptoms: reduced endurance; cell imbalance; charge-time increase; early RTH
failure_modes.mitigation: balance charge; cool storage; retire below 80% capacity; avoid deep discharge

failure_modes.name: gimbal_jitter
failure_modes.symptoms: gimbal jitter; horizon tilt; motor overload; video shake
failure_modes.mitigation: calibrate gimbal; avoid impact; firmware update; replace gimbal motor on overload

failure_modes.name: thermal_sensor_calibration_drift
failure_modes.symptoms: temperature reading offset; hot/cold spot artifacts; NUC failure; radiometric drift
failure_modes.mitigation: periodic non-uniformity correction; ambient calibration; shield from direct sun; recalibrate

failure_modes.name: connector_wear
failure_modes.symptoms: intermittent power; contact resistance rise; sparking; loose fit
failure_modes.mitigation: inspect pins; clean contacts; replace worn connector; correct insertion force
